MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Mamas & the Papas greatest hits feels like a natural next choice after Simon & Garfunkel, Melanie, and my mid-’60s compilation because I’m drawn to melodic songs from that period.",
    "Journey Greatest Hits fits my interest in classic-rock compilations: I can revisit familiar, tuneful songs instead of exploring an unfamiliar album."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Master of Puppets, Load, and Hybrid Theory are much heavier or more aggressive than the melodic classics I want during this visit.",
    "Atom Heart Mother and The Endless River share an older-rock connection, but extended experimental or atmospheric instrumental music does not satisfy my current interest in familiar, song-focused hits.",
    "25, A Rush of Blood to the Head, and Hot Fuss feel less relevant because my occasional interest in newer pop does not outweigh my current pull toward older favorites."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in classic rock seems to have been stretched into an interest in heavy or aggressive rock, even though those listening experiences feel quite different to me.",
    "My interactions with Born This Way and Cheek to Cheek seem to have been taken as a broad invitation to recommend newer albums, while my repeated choices of older hits feel more relevant right now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose best-of and greatest-hits collections, which reflects my desire to hear familiar songs rather than explore full albums.",
    "The melodic folk-pop connection among Simon & Garfunkel, Melanie, and my ’60s compilation matters more to me right now than simply sharing a rock label or an older release era."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in older hits but stretch it too broadly across rock styles and newer albums, missing my current preference for familiar, melodic songs."
}
